story.title: Review feedback
story.user_story: Verify Review on the testing server with an existing signed-in testing account. This story creates one clearly labelled validation review in Grist and does not change laboratory records.

steps.do: Open the Review panel on testing, enter your reviewer name, and open the story picker.
steps.expect: Both testing stories are available: Application startup and retained analyzers, and Review feedback.

steps.do: Mark the preceding Review step, add a note starting with 'Testing deployment validation', and download the report.
steps.expect: The report retains the mark and note and identifies the testing instance and selected story. Deployment metadata is included when available; unavailable metadata is not presented as a verified commit.

steps.do: While signed in, submit this validation review once. Retain the downloaded report if submission fails; do not repeatedly submit it.
steps.expect: The panel confirms submission under the verified application login and the reviewer name you entered.
